summary: Master workplace safety leadership for supervisors with practical tools, inspections, incident analysis, and dashboards. Train your team to work safer.
lede: Safety leadership training gives supervisors practical ways to build safety routines into daily work. It is designed for frontline supervisors, shift leaders, operations supervisors and safety coordinators responsible for inspections, coaching and incident follow-up. Participants practise identifying hazards with Job Safety Analysis, using checklists and toolbox talks, and investigating incidents to track corrective actions and report safety trends.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who supervise work and need a practical way to lead safety in real operations. It fits roles that carry daily responsibility for inspections, coaching, incident response, and reporting.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, basic spreadsheet skills, and familiarity with your site’s safety procedures, inspection records, or incident forms. If possible, bring a recent checklist, toolbox talk record, or incident example from your own work context.
